title: Autoloader subsystem (dynamic attributes)
description: Per-instance attributes of an autoloader: the service channels this loader accepts, and the discovery table it uses to query its upstream ammo rack. A loader is both the provider for downstream launchers and the consumer of an upstream rack, so both fields live on the instance.

definition.description: Resource location of the subsystem model, pointing at the matching autoloader static attribute definition.

ammo_discovery_inputs.description: Service channels this loader accepts. Downstream launchers run a read-only discovery on these channels and find this loader. Channels express a service class only (e.g. ammo_57mm) and carry no business signals.

ammo_discovery_targets.description: Upstream query table: service channel to target names. First-party content points at the matching rack subsystem by name, so the scope covers exactly that pair. The upstream query accepts stock holders only; loaders never accept other loaders, so a mechanical chain cannot cycle.
